description: Interventi Strade is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Città Metropolitana di Napoli. Bandi per l'esecuzione di interventi sulle strade di competenza della Città Metropolitana di Napoli. Interventi finanziati con applicazione del Bilancio 2018/2020 dell’avanzo di amministrazione, fondi vincolati per spese di investimento derivanti da risorse trasferite dallo Stato ex d.lgs. n.504 del 30 dicembre 1992, art. 41, con imputazione contabile sull’annualità 2019. Coverage: Città Metropolitana di Napoli. The portal files it under the publisher Città Metropolitana di Napoli. Its tags are N_A. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-06-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
